name: Jev Chat Assistant for macOS
description: macOS floating-window chat copilot: reads the visible chat via window-cropped screenshots + Apple Vision OCR (or the accessibility text API), sends it to Jev for an 8-way intent Choice and a 0-9 risk Score, or to a local model for offline judging; drafts tone-matched replies, re-ranks them locally, and fills the pick in — never sends.
